\

A report completed as a technical report in in [STAT 454 - Bayesian Statistics](https://catalog.macalester.edu/preview_course_nopop.php?catoid=28&coid=145414) in the spring of 2026. This project uses a Bayesian hierarchical logistic regression model to analyze whether using a Power Play in mixed doubles curling affects the U.S. team’s probability of winning a match.

\

This report was created by [Katelyn McClure](https://katelynmcclure.github.io){target="_blank"} and [Isa Chen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinglei-chen-267364301/){target="_blank"} for Professor Taylor Okonek.
